Accomplishment
1. Invited speaker, research scholar, and lecturer for various conferences (including TAA, NATPA, etc.), centers, institutes, and universities in and out of the USA.

2. The First Taiwanese American woman who receive Ph.D. in Economics. Univ. of Rochester 1967) and appointed to a Major university (NYU) as an Assistant Professor 1967

Publication
1. Development Strategies of Open Economies: Cases from Emerging East and Southeast Asia, with Frank S.T. Hsiao (FSTH). World Scientific (WS), 2020, xxxviii+338 pp.

2. Economic Development of Emerging East Asia: Catching Up of Taiwan and South Korea (with FSTH), Anthem Press, 2017, xxii+293 pp. Cambridge University Press Cambridge Core, 2018.

3. Economic Development of Taiwan – Early Experiences and the Pacific Trade Triangle (with FSTH). WS, 2015, xxi+578 pp.

Many other publications in professional journals and book chapters.

Hobby
Watching financial and stock market operations, Learning, Reading, Traveling.

Notable Accomplishments

Invited speaker, research scholar, and lecturer for various conferences (including TAA, NATPA, etc.), centers, institutes, and universities in and out of the USA.

The first Taiwanese American woman to receive a Ph.D. in Economics (University of Rochester, 1967) and to be appointed to a major university (NYU) as an Assistant Professor (1967).

Co-authored 'Development Strategies of Open Economies: Cases from Emerging East and Southeast Asia' (World Scientific, 2020).

Co-authored 'Economic Development of Emerging East Asia: Catching Up of Taiwan and South Korea' (Anthem Press, 2017; Cambridge University Press Cambridge Core, 2018).

Co-authored 'Economic Development of Taiwan - Early Experiences and the Pacific Trade Triangle' (World Scientific, 2015).

Many other publications in professional journals and book chapters.
